note: `styled['div']` and `` styled[`div`] `` compile as `styled.div` does, in tagged templates and calls and before `.attrs` / `.withConfig`, for Emotion, styled-components and Devup UI's own `styled`, keeping Emotion's numbers as pixels. A computed tag the build cannot read (`styled[tag]`) or that no `styled.` member could spell (`styled['my-element']`) stays a located build error
